Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Falcon: Delivers an attack with a potency of 10 to all enemies at the designated area.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: Stun</br>Duration: 4s</br>Additional Effect: Triggers traps at the designated area
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Unicorn: Creates a barrier around self and all party members near you that absorbs 40,000 damage.</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Phantom Aim: Increases critical hit rate and direct hit rate by 50％ and guarantees that all attacks land.</br>Effect does not apply to healing actions.</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Phantom Aim: Improves Phantom Aim's critical hit rate and direct hit rate increase to 30%, and guarantees all attacks land.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Phantom Aim II: Improves Phantom Aim's critical hit rate and direct hit rate increase to 50%, and guarantees all attacks land.
